grammar.title: Present Perfect — Experiência Profissional
rules: Present perfect (have/has + particípio) fala de experiências sem tempo específico: I have worked in marketing for five years.
"Ever" em perguntas pergunta sobre experiência: Have you ever worked abroad?
"Never" nega experiência: We have never missed a deadline.
